hero.title: Build a career with direction
hero.subtitle: Clarity, strategy, and momentum for your next move.
hero.body: From job search to long-term growth, Horizon helps you understand where you stand, choose the smartest next step, and keep moving with confidence.

proof.guidance: A calm workspace for applications, companies, documents, and decisions.
proof.documents: AI-assisted CV, cover letter, and role-specific document preparation.
proof.practice: Interview practice and follow-up planning tied to real opportunities.

pillars.title: Less noise. More useful next steps.
pillars.subtitle: Horizon is not a one-time job search tool. It is a structured career workspace for the decisions that shape your next role and the one after it.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: See your pipeline, role fit, company context, and risks without switching between scattered notes and spreadsheets.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.body: Turn job descriptions, company research, and your profile into sharper positioning, tailored documents, and better questions.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.body: Know what to do today: follow up, prepare, improve a document, research a company, or move an opportunity forward.

workspace.title: Everything around an opportunity lives in one guided flow.
workspace.body: Horizon connects the work candidates already do: research, tracking, CV editing, cover letters, interview preparation, and offer thinking. The AI guide supports the workflow without turning the product into a noisy chat screen.
workspace.previewSubtitle: Role context, documents, practice, and next actions

outcomes.nextMove: Get a practical next move based on status, deadlines, and missing context.
outcomes.fit: Understand fit and gaps before sending a generic application.
outcomes.followUp: Keep follow-ups and interview preparation connected to the actual role.

research.title: Research
research.body: Capture company context, role signals, and questions worth asking.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Create and revise CVs, cover letters, and role-specific notes with controlled AI help.

applications.title: Applications
applications.body: Track status, deadlines, contacts, follow-ups, and decisions in one place.

practice.title: Interview practice
practice.body: Prepare answers, rehearse stories, and build a clearer interview narrative.

pricing.eyebrow: A product people can grow into
pricing.title: Start simple, pay for serious career leverage.
pricing.body: The first paid layer should earn its place: stronger document generation, deeper role research, interview coaching, and a Horizon Guide that understands the user’s whole career context.
pricing.planBody: For active job seekers and ambitious professionals who want structure, better decisions, and less manual work.

benefits.tracker: Unlimited applications and company research spaces.
benefits.documents: CV and cover letter generation with role-specific revision guidance.
benefits.interview: Interview practice plans, answer feedback, and follow-up suggestions.
benefits.guide: Horizon Guide context across applications, documents, and goals.

closing.title: Build the next move with direction, not reaction.
closing.body: Horizon helps people move through job search and long-term growth with a calmer system, clearer decisions, and steady progress.

decision.body: You have offer-stage signal. The next move is response quality, not more volume.
decision.recommendation: Review compensation, timing, and negotiation notes before replying.

noLoops.label: Activity without loops
noLoops.body: You have application activity, but no active interview loop yet.
noLoops.recommendation: Tighten fit analysis and follow up on warm applications before adding noise.

thinFunnel.label: Top of funnel is thin
thinFunnel.body: Momentum is low because there are not enough targeted opportunities in motion.
thinFunnel.recommendation: Add three well-fit roles this week before optimizing details.

interview.label: Interview leverage
interview.body: Your strongest signal is in active interview loops.
interview.recommendation: Prepare role-specific stories and questions before sending more applications.

healthy.label: Healthy rhythm
healthy.body: Your pipeline has useful activity. Keep the cadence steady.

building.label: Momentum building
building.body: Your profile readiness is improving, but the application pace still needs work.
building.recommendation: Protect the next action: follow up, tailor one document, or add one strong role.

empty.label: No pipeline yet
empty.body: Start with one opportunity. Horizon will turn it into a guided workflow.
empty.recommendation: Add one role with a real job description.

decision.label: Decision stage
decision.body: You have offer-stage traction. Reduce risk before optimizing volume.
decision.recommendation: Review compensation, timing, and negotiation notes.

topHeavy.label: Top-heavy pipeline
topHeavy.body: Applications are not turning into conversations yet.
topHeavy.recommendation: Review fit, strengthen the CV angle, and follow up on warm roles.

screening.label: Screening bottleneck
screening.body: You have early conversations, but no active interview loop.
screening.recommendation: Prepare sharper stories and role-specific questions.

activeLoop.label: Active loop
activeLoop.body: Your strongest signal is already in motion.
activeLoop.recommendation: Prioritize interview prep before adding more applications.

forming.label: Flow is forming
forming.body: The pipeline has activity, but no clear pressure point yet.
forming.recommendation: Keep one follow-up and one new role moving each week.

drawer.placeholder: Ask anything about your career workflow...
drawer.welcomeBody: I can help with pipeline summaries, follow-up strategy, and interview preparation. Try asking for a next best action.

responses.nextBody: Review your active interviews and prepare STAR examples for upcoming sessions.
responses.followBody: Send concise updates to pending applications. Mention one relevant achievement and reconfirm interest.
responses.interviewBody: Build a 30-60-90 narrative and rehearse STAR answers focused on ownership and ambiguity.
responses.fallbackBody: Try: summary, next action, follow-ups, or interview prep.
